FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: Course this playercards activity belongs to

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Name field for Moodle instances

FIELD.NAME: intro
FIELD.COMMENT: General introduction of the playercards activity

FIELD.NAME: introformat
FIELD.COMMENT: Format of the intro field

FIELD.NAME: aidifficultydefault
FIELD.COMMENT: Default AI difficulty offered at match start: easy, normal or hard

FIELD.NAME: questionsource
FIELD.COMMENT: Bitmask: 1=own question pool, 2=real Moodle question bank (core_question)

FIELD.NAME: quiztimerseconds
FIELD.COMMENT: Quiz card answer timer, in seconds (15-30 recommended)

FIELD.NAME: maxturns
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional match turn limit; 0 means unlimited

FIELD.NAME: completionwins
FIELD.COMMENT: Custom completion rule: number of wins required; 0 disables the rule

FIELD.NAME: grade
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum grade for this activity

FIELD.NAME: gradepass
FIELD.COMMENT: Minimum grade to pass

FIELD.NAME: grademethod
FIELD.COMMENT: Method used to calculate the final grade from attempts

FIELD.NAME: hud_card_cost_item
FIELD.COMMENT: block_playerhud item ID used as currency to buy cards (0 = unconfigured)

FIELD.NAME: hud_card_cost_qty
FIELD.COMMENT: Base quantity of hud_card_cost_item charged per card purchase

FIELD.NAME: hud_retry_cost_item
FIELD.COMMENT: block_playerhud item ID charged for a new match attempt (0 = unconfigured)

FIELD.NAME: hud_retry_cost_qty
FIELD.COMMENT: Quantity of hud_retry_cost_item charged per retry

TABLE.NAME: playercards_guardians
TABLE.COMMENT: Global fixed catalog of Guardian cards, shared across every course/instance (SCOPE.md 17)

FIELD.NAME: level
FIELD.COMMENT: Guardian level, 1 to 5

FIELD.NAME: atk
FIELD.COMMENT: Attack points; atk + def must equal 400 * level, validated on write

FIELD.NAME: def
FIELD.COMMENT: Defence points; atk + def must equal 400 * level, validated on write

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Card name

FIELD.NAME: description
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional flavour text

FIELD.NAME: imagefile
FIELD.COMMENT: Path to the card art asset

FIELD.NAME: maxcopies
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum copies of this card allowed per deck

TABLE.NAME: playercards_lore
TABLE.COMMENT: Lore cards (Info/Quiz/Trap) authored by the teacher, per instance

FIELD.NAME: playercardsid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to playercards

FIELD.NAME: subtype
FIELD.COMMENT: info | quiz | trap

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Card name

FIELD.NAME: content
FIELD.COMMENT: Educational text (Info) or effect description

FIELD.NAME: effecttype
FIELD.COMMENT: Effect identifier; enable_promotion is only valid when subtype is info or quiz

FIELD.NAME: effectvalue
FIELD.COMMENT: Numeric value used by effecttype

FIELD.NAME: maxcopies
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum copies of this card allowed per deck

FIELD.NAME: difficulty
FIELD.COMMENT: easy | medium | hard; required only when subtype is quiz

FIELD.NAME: questionsource
FIELD.COMMENT: own | bank; applies when subtype is info or quiz

FIELD.NAME: questioncategory
FIELD.COMMENT: question_categories.id (bank source) or playercards_questions.category (own source); drawn at random on each activation

FIELD.NAME: createdby
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to user: the teacher who authored this card

TABLE.NAME: playercards_questions
TABLE.COMMENT: Own question/content pool, fallback to the real Moodle question bank (mirrors playerpuzzle_questions)

FIELD.NAME: playercardsid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to playercards

FIELD.NAME: category
FIELD.COMMENT: Free-form label set by the teacher, groups items drawable by the same Lore card

FIELD.NAME: qtype
FIELD.COMMENT: multichoice | truefalse (Quiz) | description (Info, no answer)

FIELD.NAME: questiontext
FIELD.COMMENT: Question or informational text

FIELD.NAME: answers
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array of {text, correct}; null when qtype is description

FIELD.NAME: approved
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the teacher approved this item for play

FIELD.NAME: addedby
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to user: the teacher who added this item

TABLE.NAME: playercards_ownership
TABLE.COMMENT: Student card collection, scoped per instance (same course scope as PlayerHUD items)

FIELD.NAME: playercardsid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to playercards

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to user

FIELD.NAME: cardtype
FIELD.COMMENT: guardian | lore

FIELD.NAME: cardid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to playercards_guardians or playercards_lore, depending on cardtype

FIELD.NAME: quantity
FIELD.COMMENT: Copies owned; cards are permanent, never decremented by play

TABLE.NAME: playercards_decks
TABLE.COMMENT: Student saved decks (per instance) or global AI reference decks (playercardsid null)

FIELD.NAME: playercardsid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to playercards; null for the global AI reference decks

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to user; null for the global AI reference decks

FIELD.NAME: aidifficulty
FIELD.COMMENT: easy | normal | hard; set only on the 3 fixed AI reference decks

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Deck name

FIELD.NAME: size
FIELD.COMMENT: Total card count, 40 to 60

FIELD.NAME: active
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether this is the student's currently selected deck; irrelevant for AI decks

FIELD.NAME: deckid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to playercards_decks

FIELD.NAME: cardtype
FIELD.COMMENT: guardian | lore

FIELD.NAME: cardid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to playercards_guardians or playercards_lore, depending on cardtype

FIELD.NAME: quantity
FIELD.COMMENT: Copies of this card included in the deck

FIELD.NAME: playercardsid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to playercards

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to user

FIELD.NAME: deckid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to playercards_decks: the deck used in this match

FIELD.NAME: aidifficulty
FIELD.COMMENT: easy | normal | hard

FIELD.NAME: result
FIELD.COMMENT: win | loss

FIELD.NAME: lpremaining
FIELD.COMMENT: Life points remaining at match end

FIELD.NAME: turnsplayed
FIELD.COMMENT: Total number of individual turns played

FIELD.NAME: score
FIELD.COMMENT: Grade contribution of this attempt
